description: Make Codex inline execution the safe default while preserving explicit sub-agent opt-in
changelog:
**Codex dispatch safety:**
- `codex.dispatch_mode` now defaults to `inline`, so the main Codex session implements and checks work itself unless a project explicitly opts into Trellis sub-agent dispatch.
- Inline mode disables Trellis-managed automatic dispatch; it still permits Codex native sub-agents when the user explicitly authorizes them for the current task under applicable governance.
- Set `codex.dispatch_mode: auto` in `.trellis/config.yaml` to keep Trellis-managed Codex sub-agent dispatch. The legacy `sub-agent` value remains an alias for `auto`.
- New Codex tasks no longer seed implement/check JSONL files in the default inline mode; explicit `auto` projects keep the existing JSONL and native `SubagentStart` flow.
- Invalid dispatch values continue to fail closed to inline mode.
notes: Upgrade both Ecochain Trellis packages, run `trellis update` in each project, then start a new Codex session. No `--migrate` flag is required. Projects with no explicit `codex.dispatch_mode` become inline by default; projects already set to `auto` or the legacy `sub-agent` alias keep sub-agent dispatch.
